test_cases.prompt: This test is flaky on CI. Help me debug it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill to build feedback loop, reproduce, minimize, hypothesize, instrument, fix.
test_cases.notes: Flaky test is a key trigger for hard bugs.

test_cases.prompt: The API is 3x slower after the deploy. Diagnose the regression.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill with perf branch: establish baseline, then bisect.
test_cases.notes: Performance regression is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: This bug works locally but fails in production. What's going on?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill to replay captured trace or HITL script for environment-specific bug.
Invokes implement skill instead. Implement builds features; diagnosing-bugs finds root cause of bugs.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for building code.

test_cases.prompt: Review this PR for code quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead. Code-review checks static diff; diagnosing-bugs needs dynamic loop.
test_cases.notes: code-review is the sibling skill for evaluating diffs.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes codebase-design skill instead. Codebase-design shapes future modules; diagnosing-bugs finds why something is broken.
test_cases.notes: codebase-design is the sibling skill for module design.

test_cases.prompt: Nobody knows this legacy code. It throws errors randomly.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill with throwaway harness to isolate code path for unknown codebase bug.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: legacy code with no domain knowledge requires diagnosing-bugs' minimization and hypothesis cycle.
